title: test_signature.rs: ECDSA, Ed25519, Ed448, RSA via signature traits (PR #10248)
description:
Write tests/test_signature.rs: test signature::Signer/Verifier impls for ECDSA P-256/384/521, Ed25519, Ed448, RSA PKCS#1v1.5 against Wycheproof + RFC 8032 vectors.

## What
Verify that signature trait impls (PR #10248) accept valid signatures and reject invalid ones using external test vectors.

## Algorithm
1. ECDSA (verify path from Wycheproof):
   a. For each curve in [secp256r1, secp384r1, secp521r1]:
      - load external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/ecdsa_{curve}_sha{n}_test.json (or p1363 variant)
      - For each valid case: parse public key from DER, use signature::Verifier::verify(pk, msg_hash, sig) → assert Ok
      - For each invalid case: verify() → assert Err
   b. For signing path: generate a key pair using wolfcrypt API, sign a test message, verify the resulting signature with Verifier — two independent code paths.
2. Ed25519:
   a. Load external/wychcheck/testvectors_rfc/rfc8032_eddsa_test.json
   b. For each test vector: use Signer to sign msg with private key sk → assert sig == expected
   c. Use Verifier to verify sig with public key pk → assert Ok
3. Ed448: same as Ed25519 but from rfc8032 Ed448 section.
4. RSA PKCS#1v1.5 (verify only):
   a. Load external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/rsa_signature_2048_sha256_test.json
   b. For each valid: parse public key, Verifier::verify(pk, msg, sig) → assert Ok
   c. For each invalid: verify() → assert Err
5. Compile-time check: fn _signer<S: signature::Signer<SomeType>>() {} for ECDSA/Ed types.

## Defensive rules
- Never use the wolfcrypt C ECC/RSA API directly in tests; always go through signature trait
- Public key parsing: DER format; use type specified in PR #10248 (check exact key type names)
- Signature format: ECDSA P1363 vs DER — must match what Wycheproof JSON uses (check 'schema' field in JSON)
- If PR #10248 is absent from local tree, this file will not compile; this is expected and documents the dependency

## Agent team
- Agent R: read PR #10248 ecdsa.rs and rsa_pkcs1v15.rs to determine exact key and signature types; determine whether ECDSA uses DER or P1363 encoding; read wycheproof JSON schema field
- Agent I: write test_signature.rs per algorithm above
- Agent T: independently verify one Wycheproof ECDSA P-256 vector using OpenSSL CLI: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature sig.bin msg.bin

## Tests (oracles)
- ECDSA P-256: Wycheproof ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256_test.json (valid+invalid)
- ECDSA P-384: Wycheproof ecdsa_secp384r1_sha384_p1363_test.json
- Ed25519: RFC 8032 test vectors via wychcheck/testvectors_rfc/rfc8032_eddsa_test.json
- RSA-2048-SHA-256: Wycheproof rsa_signature_2048_sha256_test.json
